uninstall_script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
export HOME="${HOME:-/root}"
export BUN_INSTALL="${BUN_INSTALL:-$HOME/.bun}"

echo "==> Removing Bun"
rm -rf "$BUN_INSTALL"
rm -f /usr/local/bin/bun /usr/local/bin/bunx 2>/dev/null || true
rm -f /etc/profile.d/bun.sh 2>/dev/null || true
for f in "$HOME/.bashrc" "$HOME/.profile" /etc/profile; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  tmp="$(mktemp)"
  grep -vE 'BUN_INSTALL|\.bun/bin' "$f" > "$tmp" || true
  mv "$tmp" "$f"
done
echo "==> Bun fully removed"
upgrade_script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
export HOME="${HOME:-/root}"
export BUN_INSTALL="${BUN_INSTALL:-$HOME/.bun}"
export PATH="$BUN_INSTALL/bin:$PATH"

if command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "==> Upgrading Bun via bun upgrade"
  bun upgrade || true
fi

if [ -z "${1:-}" ]; then
  BUN_VERSION="1.4.5"
else
  BUN_VERSION="$1"
fi
case "$BUN_VERSION" in
  bun-v*) ;;
  v*) BUN_VERSION="bun-$BUN_VERSION" ;;
  *) BUN_VERSION="bun-v$BUN_VERSION" ;;
esac

echo "==> Reinstalling Bun $BUN_VERSION"
curl -fsSL https://bun.com/install | bash -s "$BUN_VERSION"
export PATH="$BUN_INSTALL/bin:$PATH"
if [ -x "$BUN_INSTALL/bin/bun" ]; then
  ln -sfn "$BUN_INSTALL/bin/bun" /usr/local/bin/bun
  ln -sfn "$BUN_INSTALL/bin/bunx" /usr/local/bin/bunx 2>/dev/null || true
fi
echo "==> $(bun --version)"
install_script:
#!/bin/bash
# Install Bun runtime via official installer (https://bun.com)
set -euo pipefail

export HOME="${HOME:-/root}"
export USER="${USER:-root}"
mkdir -p "$HOME"

if [ -z "${1:-}" ]; then
  BUN_VERSION="1.4.5"
else
  BUN_VERSION="$1"
fi
# Accept either 1.4.5 or bun-v1.4.5
case "$BUN_VERSION" in
  bun-v*) ;;
  v*) BUN_VERSION="bun-$BUN_VERSION" ;;
  *) BUN_VERSION="bun-v$BUN_VERSION" ;;
esac

echo "==> Installing Bun $BUN_VERSION"

if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
  apt-get update -y || true
  apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl unzip || true
elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  dnf -y install ca-certificates curl unzip || true
elif command -v apk >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  apk add --no-cache ca-certificates curl unzip || true
fi

curl -fsSL https://bun.com/install | bash -s "$BUN_VERSION"

export BUN_INSTALL="${BUN_INSTALL:-$HOME/.bun}"
export PATH="$BUN_INSTALL/bin:$PATH"

# System-wide PATH for all users
install -d -m 755 /etc/profile.d
cat >/etc/profile.d/bun.sh <<EOF
export BUN_INSTALL="\$HOME/.bun"
export PATH="\$BUN_INSTALL/bin:\$PATH"
EOF
chmod 644 /etc/profile.d/bun.sh

# Symlink into /usr/local/bin for non-login shells
if [ -x "$BUN_INSTALL/bin/bun" ]; then
  ln -sfn "$BUN_INSTALL/bin/bun" /usr/local/bin/bun
  ln -sfn "$BUN_INSTALL/bin/bunx" /usr/local/bin/bunx 2>/dev/null || true
fi

echo "==> $(bun --version) ($(command -v bun))"
echo "==> Bun installed (see https://bun.com)"
